Identify a Plant

Photograph something growing and see what Plantdex thinks it might be.

If it is a plant we have a card for, you can add it to your collection. Anything else can go on your Seed Shelf.

The answer is a suggestion to check, not a verdict.

Level 1 Seedling

0 / 250 XP

250 XP to Level 2. Every plant in the deck you find earns you XP.

Daily scan goal

5 of 5 left today

Take 2 or 3 photos of the same plant — the same individual, not two plants of the same kind.

+

Whole plant

1. Required. Step back. Show its overall shape and how it grows.
+

Leaf + stem

2. Required. Get close and fill the frame with one leaf and where it joins the stem. Other plants in the shot will confuse the result.
+

Detail

(optional)

3. Optional. A flower, fruit or the most distinctive feature you can find.

0 of 3 added · 2 photos required · 3 recommended

Fill the frame with one plant

Get Identification
→

Add 2 more photos to identify.

A SUGGESTION, NOT AN IDENTIFICATION

This is a guess made from a photograph. It is not confirmation that you have found this plant, and it says nothing at all about whether the plant can be eaten, drunk, applied or handled without harm.

Check it against the card and against a second source before you act on it. Never consume or apply a wild plant on an identification you are not certain of — including a certain-looking one from a phone.

You can scan without an account. Signed in, your scan history is kept — signed out, nothing is saved anywhere.

HERBAL SAFETY

An identification from a photograph is a starting point, not proof. Never eat, drink or apply a wild plant on one.

For education only — not medical advice.

Read full safety information →

FORAGING SAFETY: Avoid eating or using plants from areas that may have been treated with pesticides, herbicides, or other chemicals. If you’re unsure whether an area was sprayed, don’t consume the plant.
